mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stat_access_daily WHERE stat_date = CURDATE()
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stat_access_daily ( stat_date, site_id, site_code, user_type, bucket_hour, pv, uv, unique_users, avg_response_ms, p95_response_ms, err_4xx, err_5xx, bytes_sent ) SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, site_id, MAX(site_code) AS site_code, user_type, bucket_hour, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id) AS unique_users, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(response_ms), 0)) AS avg_response_ms, IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_pct >= 0.95 THEN response_ms END), 0) AS p95_response_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS err_4xx, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS err_5xx, IFNULL(SUM(bytes_sent), 0) AS bytes_sent FROM ( SELECT site_id, site_code, COALESCE(actor_user_type, 'ANONYMOUS') AS user_type, HOUR(logged_at) AS bucket_hour, client_ip, actor_user_id, response_ms, status_code, bytes_sent, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, COALESCE(actor_user_type,'ANONYMOUS'), HOUR(logged_at) ORDER BY response_ms) AS rn_pct FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) t GROUP BY site_id, user_type, bucket_hour
UNION ALL
-- 부분합 (a) 사이트별 — user_type/bucket_hour NULL → ② 사이트별 점유율 -- site_code 는 GROUP BY 에서 제외 (UNIQUE KEY 가 site_id 만 포함하므로 같은 site_id 의 -- 과거/현재 site_code 가 섞여 있어도 한 행으로 합친다 — 2026-04-30 dup-key 회귀 방지) SELECT #{statDate}, site_id, MAX(site_code), NULL, NULL, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip), COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id), ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(response_ms), 0)), 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), IFNULL(SUM(bytes_sent), 0) FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY site_id
UNION ALL
-- 부분합 (b) 사용자 유형별 — site/bucket_hour NULL → ③ 사용자 유형 분포 SELECT #{statDate}, NULL, NULL, COALESCE(actor_user_type, 'ANONYMOUS') AS user_type, NULL, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip), COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id), ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(response_ms), 0)), 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), IFNULL(SUM(bytes_sent), 0) FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY COALESCE(actor_user_type, 'ANONYMOUS')
UNION ALL
-- 부분합 (c) 시간대별 — site/user_type NULL → ④ 시간대별 트래픽 SELECT #{statDate}, NULL, NULL, NULL, HOUR(logged_at) AS bucket_hour, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip), COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id), ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(response_ms), 0)), 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), IFNULL(SUM(bytes_sent), 0) FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(logged_at)
UNION ALL
-- 부분합 (d) 전체 합계 — 모두 NULL → 요약 카드용 totalPv 등 SELECT #{statDate}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip), COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_id), ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(response_ms), 0)), 0, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 AND status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), IFNULL(SUM(bytes_sent), 0) FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stat_access_uri_daily WHERE stat_date = CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_access_uri_daily ( stat_date, site_id, site_code, request_uri, pv, uv, avg_response_ms ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, site_id, site_code, request_uri, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) AS uv, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(response_ms),0)) AS avg_response_ms FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY site_id, site_code, request_uri ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT 1000 ) t

mapper.select:
SELECT NULL AS stat_id, MAX(stat_date) AS stat_date, site_id, site_code, NULL AS user_type, NULL AS bucket_hour, SUM(pv) AS pv, SUM(uv) AS uv, SUM(unique_users) AS unique_users, ROUND(AVG(avg_response_ms)) AS avg_response_ms, 0 AS p95_response_ms, SUM(err_4xx) AS err_4xx, SUM(err_5xx) AS err_5xx, SUM(bytes_sent) AS bytes_sent, NOW() AS computed_at FROM stat_access_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND user_type IS NULL AND bucket_hour IS NULL
GROUP BY site_id, site_code ORDER BY pv DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_daily_visit ( stat_date, site_id, visit_count, unique_count, pv_count, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, site_id, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id, client_ip)) AS visit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) AS unique_count, COUNT(*) AS pv_count, 'SYSTEM', '127.0.0.1', NOW(), 'SYSTEM', '127.0.0.1', NOW() FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND site_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY site_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_count = VALUES(visit_count), unique_count = VALUES(unique_count), pv_count = VALUES(pv_count), updated_by = 'SYSTEM', updated_ip = '127.0.0.1', updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(v.stat_date) AS stat_date, v.site_id, s.site_code AS site_code, SUM(v.visit_count) AS visit_count, SUM(v.unique_count) AS unique_count, SUM(v.pv_count) AS pv_count FROM stat_daily_visit v LEFT JOIN gopcms_primary.tb_site s ON s.site_id = v.site_id WHERE v.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY v.site_id, s.site_code ORDER BY pv_count DESC
